text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, this place is the real deal! I'm way<n>out of
my element!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
To explain why we're here, we have to<n>go back a
little bit. It all began when<n>Нишино Флауэр
approached Tosen<n>Jordan for advice...

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
So, I put a photo of my nails on Umatter,<n>and
someone commented suggesting I<n>make a
nail-themed packed lunch.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I thought that sounded fun... but I can't<n>come up
with a good idea. I want to<n>make something
stylish—what do you<n>think?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You want it to look glam for the<n>photos,
yeah? How about these? I keep<n>seeing them on
my feed.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Japanese sweets! They'd look super<n>cute in
the lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
But... I've never made anything so<n>highbrow
before...

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Uh... Who said anything about<n>eyebrows?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, if it's about sweets, I know just<n>who to
ask.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Japanese sweets? Then I'd recommend a<n>
workshop for beginners. The experts will<n>guide
you through all the steps.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I'm rather interested myself, actually.<n>Would it be
all right if I tagged along<n>when you go?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Oh, totes. Can you handle the<n>reservation, then?
You know way more<n>about this stuff and all.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
They also figured having a chaperone<n>would be
preferable, which is the exact<n>moment I happened
to pass by...

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I can sense a solemn adherence to<n>tradition and
ceremony. I think we'll<n>have a great experience
making sweets.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: I don't think I could be more out of<n>place...

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I-it's okay, we're in this together! Um... I<n>think we
get to try some tea and sweets<n>before the
workshop begins.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
A private room?! We're not gonna have<n>to be all
prim and proper, are we?!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I read a book on Japanese culture once<n>that said
Japanese sweets go hand in<n>hand with formal tea
ceremonies.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my intrusion. We will now be<n>preparing
your tea.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
A number of kimono-clad staff enter the<n>room.
They place trays of traditional<n>sweets before us
and begin preparing<n>the tea.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text: Please, help yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Huh? We're already eating?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think it's proper etiquette to finish<n>the
sweets before the tea.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text: Yes, I read that as well. It was quite<n>surprising.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
You know your stuff, huh, Flower? Help<n>a girl out
here—I'm in way over my head!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I'd like your guidance too, if you don't<n>mind. I've
studied tea ceremony, but I'm<n>far from an expert.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! B-but it's not like I have<n>any formal
practice, so... I'm sorry if I get<n>anything mixed up!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Man, you're so put together, Flower.<n>Mad
respect, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I admire how open-minded you all<n>are.
Many people would find it difficult<n>to ask
someone younger for help.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I admire how open-minded you all<n>are.
Many people would find it difficult<n>to ask
someone younger for help.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that a low-key compliment?
choice_data_list:
Of course! She's praising your willingness to
learn!

Of course! She's praising your willingness to
learn!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Do pardon me for speaking out of turn.<n>Please
make yourselves at home. It<n>wouldn't be a worthy
experience if you<n>couldn't relax and enjoy
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Oh, so, like, are selfies cool?

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text: Psst, Jordan! That has to be against<n>the—

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Yes, take as many photos as<n>you'd like.
Nothing makes us happier<n>than others
appreciating Japanese<n>sweets and tea.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: M-me too! I want to take pictures of the<n>sweets!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
That workshop was a very enriching<n>experience. It
certainly helped broaden<n>my perspective on
Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
For sure. It was cool trying something<n>you
normally don't get to do.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Now I can use my knowledge about<n>making
Japanese sweets to make cute<n>decorations for my
packed lunches!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
If you need any tips with your nails, let<n>me know,
yeah? I got you.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
All is silent but for the sound of a<n>bamboo tea
whisk. I sneak a sideways<n>glance and see Tosen
Jordan and Eishin<n>Flash looking pained.

text_block_list.name: Jordan & Flash
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow! Sitting in seiza sucks! I can't<n>feel my
legs!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, I'd hazard a guess that it's<n>impolite to be
stretching like that.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: C'mon, it's just us here.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Besides, I know you're totes numb too.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! P-please don't poke me!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Um, try leaving some space between<n>your legs
and crossing your big toes. It<n>helps to avoid going
numb.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Whoa, no kidding. That's way better! ♪

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
So this is how you're supposed to sit. As<n>someone
without much experience, your<n>advice is a
lifesaver. Thank you, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, happy to help. But if it starts to<n>hurt, you
can always just say "excuse me"<n>and sit normally.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad we've got you here.<n>Like, marry
me, girl!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: C-come on, you'll make me blush!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Flower, if you notice anything wrong<n>with my
etiquette, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: Um, I don't think you have to worry<n>about that.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
The staff have already left, so that's<n>probably
their way of saying we can<n>make ourselves at
home.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
What if they're just cutting us some slack<n>after
seeing our horrible posture?

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text: Gasp! That would be... a littleembarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Meh, I say we thank them. Time to kick<n>back and
relax.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Let's enjoy the tea and the<n>sweets at our
own pace.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
The trio chatter excitedly on the way<n>back,
sharing ideas for Нишино Флауэр's<n>Umatter
photos. There's no doubt they'll<n>turn out great.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
After we take our time savoring the tea<n>and
sweets, we take part in the<n>sweets-making
workshop. From<n>beginning to end, everyone is all
smiles.
